resolutions.evidence: Real registered-Mastra/Hono regression recovers the no-snapshot pre-start dispatch, persists workflowRunId, suspends, then approves through API.
Recovery reads Mastra snapshot before case status; active snapshots restart, suspended/terminal snapshots do not fresh-start; API resume holds durable lease.
Deterministic final message/outbox IDs and finalizeCaseAndEnqueue transaction reject conflicting replay.
deliverOutbox resolves each persisted binding through the registered registry.
Dispatch/outbox ownership tokens fence completion and heartbeat renewal runs for normal start, recovery, and delivery.
Expired third claims are terminally failed and set public workflow/delivery failure metadata.
Recovery failures persist case status/escalationReason; terminal delivery failures persist deliveryStatus.
Tenant/account-scoped event identity is used through migration and inbound acceptance.
Create, update, append, and finalization write case JSON and message rows in one transaction.
Issue path compares the approved immutable support_actions payload rather than a mutable metadata hash.
Loopback request and response schemas reject invalid money, binding, receipt, and provider result shapes.
Fixture reset refuses financial or delivery history in the same write transaction as deletion.
Reset effect check and all deletes share one write transaction.
Legacy scoped case identity is atomically backfilled into support_events on replay.
Ingestion retains adapter externalConversationId independently from inbound event externalId.
Known ISO exponent mapping covers 0/2/3 decimal conversion and rejects unknown precision.
